referenceFunction.generalComment: The functional unit represents a site for the mechanical treatment of WEEE devices (including the preceding manual depollution step), with all the necessary facilities. Process data based on own estimations, using proper experiences within the Swiss e-Waste systems. The here described plant has an assumed treatment capacity of 50’000 t per year over a time span of 25 years. Update 2023: The bill of materials is assumed to remain the same, but the background datasets are updating using new ICT datasets.; Geography: This module is based on experiences in Switzerland as a proxy for the global situation.; UUID: 4d3f2267-79d2-37be-aead-51e2c96b173f
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes land use, buildings and facilities (machinery, cables, etc.) as well as the respective disposal activities of a plant for mechanical WEEE treatment.
